about.title: A Warm Family Boat in Kekova: Eras Tu
about.subtitle: Hosted by Captain Ahmet and his wife, fully private tours for up to 12 guests.
about.description: Eras Tu is a cozy 12-guest family boat operating out of Üçağız Harbour, lovingly run by Captain Ahmet and his wife. If you are looking for a Kekova private boat tour or an Üçağız boat rental, we provide the perfect setting for large family groups, circles of friends, or couples seeking a secluded escape. With our fully customizable private daily charters, you can swim in the most beautiful and pristine coves in the region, including Aquarium Cove, Tersane Bay, Gökkaya, Kocakarı Bay, and Esmeralda. You will also witness the historical majesty of Kaleköy (Simena) and the Sunken City. Captain Ahmet uses his local expertise to select the calmest coves based on daily wind and sea conditions, ensuring a comfortable and memorable day on the water.

items.q: How do I make a reservation?
items.a: Contact us on WhatsApp. Tell us your preferred date, group size and tour type. We'll confirm availability within a few hours.

items.q: Is lunch included in the tour?
items.a: Yes, our daily tours (10:00 AM - 5:00 PM) include a freshly prepared, delicious home-cooked lunch on board, along with tea and fruit service throughout the day.

items.q: What is the capacity of the boat?
items.a: Our boat can accommodate up to 12 guests. It is ideal for families or a group of friends looking for a private charter.
Absolutely. Our tours are family-friendly. Life jackets for children are provided on board.

items.q: What if the weather is bad?
items.a: Safety first. If sea conditions are not suitable, we will reschedule your tour or offer a full refund.
